paragraph: Aubry Allbridge is twenty-two and lives in Utah. An instructor at VASA Fitness in Kaysville named Jane Johnson noticed her years ago. Aubry could remember the moves better than most. Jane kept watching. Now Aubry is a certified instructor for UpBeat Barre, the popular fitness program. She leads a class of sixty people at the gym where Jane is co-owner. Her students follow the person who was once watched from across the room.
